propositions: Every newly certified plan review must bind to a deterministic set of canonical pins for direct children and prerequisites without adding ticket fields or user commands.

Plan material pins must appear in the manifest after verified-at-sha and before dep lines, sorted lexicographically by role then ID, with each fingerprint derived from the target's PlanContext material_fingerprint.

PlanRelationSnapshot must collect ticket states store-wide including archived tickets, resolve aliases/prefixes once, and emit exactly one pin per canonical ID and role; unreadable targets must raise PlanRelationSnapshotError with specific enumerated reasons before any LLM evaluation.

tracker_head_sha must verify the tickets-tracker is clean after ensure_fresh using git status --porcelain and ls-files -u, then return the 40-hex HEAD SHA, mapping all git/IO/path/subprocess failures to store-read-failure.

All plan-review signature-producing paths—ordinary sign_plan_review, refresh_attestation, and resign_plan_review—must call collect_plan_relation_snapshot and pass related_material to build_manifest; deleted pinned targets must prevent refresh/re-sign with unsigned INDETERMINATE remediation.
Legacy manifests without pins must remain authenticatable; new readers must preserve full DSSE verification and ignore unknown pin lines without reconstruction or rehashing.
